status: Exploratory static interaction concepts. Replaces the conventional dashboard direction rejected by the user; no application changes.
generation: Built-in image_gen; final prompts are in interaction-studies-prompts.json

concepts.title: Screen Keys
concepts.interaction: Press an agent's display-key to pull its workspace into focus. Drop a file onto the key to attach context.
concepts.bestFor: A distinctive home surface that makes switching agents feel immediate.
concepts.tradeoff: The key is a live thumbnail; reading and interacting happens in the expanded screen.

concepts.title: Screen Landscape
concepts.interaction: Pull any agent's screen forward to work with it; push it back to restore the overview. Snap two screens together for comparison.
concepts.bestFor: Seeing actual work while preserving a clear primary focus.
concepts.tradeoff: Use a fixed camera and flat screen layers; a navigable 3D room would reintroduce the original problem.

concepts.title: Task Pucks
concepts.interaction: Place an agent puck onto a task sheet to assign it, add source cards, then press Start. Lift the puck to inspect its workspace.
concepts.bestFor: Making assignment, ownership and shared context tangible.
concepts.tradeoff: Needs accessible keyboard equivalents and clear drop targets.

concepts.title: Agent Cartridges
concepts.interaction: Each agent is a persistent cartridge. Insert it into a project dock, attach context chips, and open its display to inspect work.
concepts.bestFor: Making agent identity, reusable roles and project scope easy to understand.
concepts.tradeoff: The metaphor must remain a shortcut to clear controls, rather than add extra steps.

concepts.title: Focus Orbit
concepts.interaction: Choose an agent on the ring to bring its work into the center. Place files and memory tokens on the inner ring to prepare context, then start explicitly.
concepts.bestFor: One focused workspace with the entire team a single gesture away.
concepts.tradeoff: Keep the ring stationary unless the user moves it; constant orbiting would be distracting.

concepts.title: Work Ribbons
concepts.interaction: Pull out an agent's ribbon of work to inspect sources, browser captures and results. Open any frame at full size and review a result before passing it on.
concepts.bestFor: Understanding a result's history without reading a long log.
concepts.tradeoff: Store selected events and captures with clear timestamps, not continuous video.
